title: A lecture on Navier-Stokes equations
summary: The content of the following pages was part of a special topics lecture given at the Australian National University during the first semester of 2026. That was a very nice expericence, I really enjoyed giving this 12 weeks (2 hours a week) lecture. It is meant to be self contained, starting with results on Fourier transform and Sobolev spaces. As a toy model, before treating the Navier-Stokes system, we focus on the non linear heat equation where the non linearity is polynomial. Ultimately, we prove existence and uniqueness of mild solutions of the Navier-Stokes equations in critical spaces.…
